subject: Arte
description_pt: Explorar diferentes tecnologias e recursos digitais (multimeios, animações, jogos eletrônicos, gravações em áudio e vídeo, fotografia, softwares etc.) nos processos de criação artística.

components.description_pt: Explorar tecnologias digitais e multimídia como ferramentas em processos de criação artística
components.description_en: Explore digital and multimedia technologies as tools in artistic creation processes
components.cc_component_description: Explore a variety of digital tools available for producing writing with adult guidance

components.description_pt: Utilizar técnicas de gravação de áudio ou vídeo em processos de criação artística
components.description_en: Use audio or video recording techniques within an artistic creation process
components.cc_component_description: Create an audio recording of a story or poem for a specific purpose

components.description_pt: Aplicar fotografia, animações ou jogos eletrônicos como recursos em criação artística
components.description_en: Apply photography, animations, or electronic games as resources in artistic creation
components.cc_component_description: Compare how a subject or key scene is represented in two different artistic mediums

cc_matches.description: With guidance and support from adults, explore a variety of digital tools to produce and publish writing, including in collaboration with peers.

Analyze the representation of a subject or a key scene in two different artistic mediums, including what is emphasized or absent in each treatment (e.g., Auden's "Musée des Beaux Arts" and Breughel's Landscape with the Fall of Icarus).
Create audio recordings of stories or poems; add drawings or other visual displays to stories or recounts of experiences when appropriate to clarify ideas, thoughts, and feelings.
